_comment: The halvex dream campaign. `target` is the repo the dreams run against (cwd of each claude -p; override per-machine with DREAM_TARGET if the checkout lives elsewhere). `scratch_dir`/`write_root` are relative to target: dreams write results into scratch_dir and the write-jail hook confines ALL writes to write_root. `env_file` (relative to target) is greped for DISCORD_DREAMS_WEBHOOK_URL. `accounts` is the strict alternation order for timer-driven runs; `dream loop --account X` overrides it. `default_interval_hours` seeds the mutable interval (`dream interval N`).
